ios.desc:
Finding the right product (laptop, phone, headphones etc. etc.) shouldn't require hours of research. Great Recs uses AI to understand exactly what you need and recommends products that actually fit your life.



**HOW IT WORKS**

Simply tell our AI what you're looking for:
• "Best laptop for video editing under $1500"
• "Lightweight headphones for running"
• "Gaming laptop with good battery life"


Within seconds, you'll get personalized recommendations with clear explanations of why each suggestion fits your needs.



**SMART RECOMMENDATIONS**

Every recommendation comes with:
→ AI-generated insights explaining the match
→ Honest pros and cons for informed decisions
→ Key specs that matter
→ Real prices from all sellers
→ Aggregated ratings from thousands of reviews



**COMPARE WITH CONFIDENCE**

Shortlist your favorites and compare them side-by-side. Our AI highlights the key differences so you can make the right choice without second-guessing.



**TRANSPARENT PRICING**

See real-time prices from major retailers. Find deals on both new and certified refurbished products. Buy directly from Best Buy or Amazon with one tap.



**BUILT FOR REAL DECISIONS**

We don't show you 500 options and leave you overwhelmed. Our AI narrows down to the products that genuinely match what you asked for — usually 5-10 curated picks.



**WHAT'S INCLUDED**

• AI-powered search that understands natural language
• 1000+ produdcts from top brands
• Real-time pricing from sellers
• New and refurbished options
• Detailed specs, reviews, and comparisons
• Shortlist to save and compare favorites



**PRIVACY FIRST**

Your searches stay private. We don't sell your data or show you ads based on your browsing.


Questions or feedback? Contact us at help@greatrecs.com

quotes.text:
I hate laptop shopping. Need to keep 20 Chrome tabs open, cross-reference specs, check pricing. "Best laptop 2026" lists are commission-optimized, not helpful. They go stale when prices shift.

Built an app that takes "lightweight laptop for coding under $1200" and returns curated picks with fresh pricing and reasoning. Currently laptops and phones.
Design: consumer journey = contraction/expansion of opportunities. Explore → AI curates → shortlist → compare. Each interaction updates recommendations via LLM.
Avoided the chatbot trap. LLMs as foundation, but keep good mobile UX (cards, scrolling, navigation).

Not sure if this beats manual research. Honest feedback wanted. iOS app: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/great-recs/id6756940360
